evidence.summary: Kernel output exceeds the 2e-5 tolerance on 70 of 71 legal test cases (shapes from 1x1 to 129x129, steps 4 and 8, random/ones/impulse/corner inputs), worst max abs error 0.21 vs the FP64 per-step reference. The fused 9-tap sweep re-imposes the zero exterior only every 4 steps instead of at each individual step, so boundary elements lose mass that the contract requires be truncated per step.

rationale: The 9-tap binomial coefficients are the fourth power of the 1D [1,2,1]/4 kernel, so temporal fusion with per-step zero padding is mathematically equivalent; FP32 accumulation should stay within the 2e-5 tolerance.

scope_evidence.summary: Contract requires U_steps per the per-step 3x3 update with zero exterior every step, FP32 output, and abs(actual-U_steps)<=2e-5 over the whole legal domain.

scope_rationale: Contract requires every element within 2e-5 of U_steps for all legal inputs; any elementwise violation on an admitted input is a defect.
statement: The kernel's output deviates from the FP64 per-step reference by more than 2e-5 on some legal input (shape/steps within the declared domain).
